title: Ramayana enters the all-time top 5 Indian films worldwide: ₹1,437.25 cr in 12 days (Sacnilk)
headline: Ramayana Crosses ₹1,400 Crore, Enters India's All-Time Top 5
caption:
Ramayana: Rise of a Legend is now one of the five highest-grossing Indian films ever. Trade tracker Sacnilk estimates Part 1 has made ₹1,437.25 crore gross worldwide in 12 days, to Monday 16 November. Its overseas figures are still preliminary.

Only four Indian films have earned more, by Sacnilk's count: Dangal (₹2,070.30 crore), Dhurandhar 2: The Revenge (₹1,813.39 crore), Baahubali 2: The Conclusion (₹1,788.06 crore) and Pushpa 2: The Rule (₹1,742.10 crore). Ramayana has passed the first Dhurandhar, RRR and KGF Chapter 2, and is about ₹305 crore short of Pushpa 2.

Koimoi's count also puts Nitesh Tiwari's film fifth, at ₹1,410.66 crore after 11 days. The makers have not confirmed these figures.

Sources: Sacnilk, Koimoi
